Landed. The build path's interior is total: toEvent, evalBasisCall, parseBlockIds, toFactorStrings, requireIdentArg/requireIntArg, inferTermTag, and the hrf_fun resolver all return Either. BlockPlan.resolve no longer needs its try/catch at all.

Two cases were added to DesignError for mistakes that had no home: UnknownBasisFunction(name, known) — carrying the calls the formula grammar knows, like UnknownContrast does — and DegenerateBasis. Both additive; ModelError.fromDesignError goes through .message, so nothing downstream matches exhaustively.

Measured on the probe table: unknown column is now MissingColumn; list-column and HRF-column as an event variable are InvalidColumnType(name, 'usable as an event variable', found); unknown basis call is UnknownBasisFunction. ErrorFidelityProbeSuite asserts the exact case per mistake and then walks 17 realistic formulas asserting none reports BuildFailed.

One throwing lookup survives on purpose. evalSubset is a recursive evaluator with a single error protocol — throw, and let resolveSubsetMaskEither name the failure InvalidSubset, which quotes the offending expression. subsetColumn is that deliberate local convention landing in a structured case, not an accidental twin a build path could pick up. Everything else that could reach a column now goes through DataTable.get.

design 157 tests, JVM+JS green; testAll green across all modules.
